name: Kimi no Jumyou ga Mienai Riyuu
original_name: 君の寿命が見えない理由
source:
"'You, why can't I see your lifespan?'  

A short romance novel game about the Grim Reaper who suddenly appeared one day and the reason why he can't see my lifespan.  

A slightly mysterious and bittersweet story woven within a limited time.
[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14207]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
“你……为什么我看不到你的寿命？”

围绕某天突然现身的死神，以及他唯独看不到“我”的寿命的缘由而展开的短篇恋爱小说游戏。

在有限时光里编织而成的、略带不可思议色彩的微苦青春物语。
[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14207]Novelgame[/url]]
